The Weekend serialiser 0x140afaf50 stores these as qualifying_times_* (group 1) and shootout_times_* (group 2). Callers: WeeklyGP 0x140bef050 and the .data1 session-results path 0x148691f3c (tail jmp after Career_Apply_SeasonResultsToStandings, current session id in an obfuscated 10-wide range)
